name: Self-Discover: Large Language Models Self-Compose Reasoning Structures
authors: Pei Zhou, Jay Pujara, Xiang Ren, Xinyun Chen, Heng-Tze Cheng, Quoc V. Le, Ed H. Chi, Denny Zhou, Swaroop Mishra, Huaixiu Steven Zheng (University of Southern California / Google DeepMind)
venue: NeurIPS 2024 (Advances in Neural Information Processing Systems, vol. 37, pp. 126032+)
reflection_object: prompt/context — specifically a task-level reasoning structure (a JSON key-value reasoning plan). In Stage 1 the LLM reflects on the task (using unlabeled examples) to SELECT, ADAPT, and IMPLEMENT atomic reasoning modules into an explicit structure; in Stage 2 instances are solved by filling in the structure. It reflects on/composes the reasoning chain template rather than revising a concrete output.
reward_or_critic_model: none (no reward/critic model; the LLM itself composes the structure via meta-task self-discovery without any verification signal)
distillation_target: prompt — the self-discovered reasoning structure (JSON reasoning plan) is a reusable task-level artifact that is composed once per task and then reused across all instances of that task; it is also shown to transfer across model families (PaLM 2-L -> GPT-4 -> Llama2).
emergent_vs_engineered: prompt/scaffold-engineered. The reflective composition is driven by an engineered 3-action meta-prompting scaffold (SELECT/ADAPT/IMPLEMENT) over a fixed seed set of 39 atomic reasoning modules (adopted from Promptbreeder, Fernando et al. 2023); it is not an RL-emergent reflective behavior.
memory_curation_mechanism: n/a — there is no growing memory store; a single self-discovered reasoning structure is produced per task (3 extra task-level inference steps) and applied to every instance. The structure is selected/adapted from a fixed seed set of 39 reasoning modules rather than accumulated over episodes.
error_localization_granularity: holistic/outcome-level — Self-Discover composes a task-level reasoning structure and does not localize errors to specific steps/tokens. (Post-hoc error analysis reports 74.7% of MATH failures stem from computation errors, but the method does not perform step-level correction.)
intra_task_vs_inter_task: inter-task — the reasoning structure is discovered once at the task level (using unlabeled task examples) and then transferred/reused across all instances of that task, and even across model families; it is not refined per individual instance.
failure_recovery_vs_avoidance: avoidance-only — Self-Discover proactively composes a better reasoning structure up front; there is no mid-trajectory recovery or post-hoc revision of a produced answer.
task_domains: QA/reasoning; math; grounded/agent reasoning (Theory-of-Mind style); general complex reasoning
benchmarks: BIG-Bench Hard (BBH, 23 tasks), Thinking for Doing (T4D) agent/social-reasoning, MATH; 25 tasks total. Models: GPT-4 (gpt-4-turbo-preview), GPT-3.5-turbo, PaLM 2-L, Llama2-70B
headline_result: On GPT-4, Self-Discover lifts BBH from 75% (CoT) to 81%, T4D from 52% (CoT) to 85%, and MATH from 71% (CoT) to 73%; improves GPT-4 and PaLM 2 on challenging reasoning by as much as 32% over CoT and outperforms CoT+Self-Consistency by >20% while using 10-40x fewer inference compute.
baselines: Direct prompting (Direct Answering), zero-shot Chain-of-Thought (CoT, Kojima et al. 2022), Plan-and-Solve (PS, Wang et al. 2023), CoT + Self-Consistency, majority voting over each module, and OPRO optimized prompts (Yang et al. 2023). Reference points: ToT/Graph-of-Thought/RAP discussed.
gains_vs_baseline: vs zero-shot CoT (GPT-4): BBH +6 points (75->81), T4D +33 points (52->85), MATH +2 points (71->73). vs CoT (PaLM 2-L): BBH +7 (60->67), T4D +29 (40->69), MATH +8.5 (42->50.5). Headline 'as much as 32%' gain over CoT (paper text/abstract); outperforms CoT-Self-Consistency by >20%; beats CoT on 21/25 tasks and Direct Answering on 23/25 (zero-shot PaLM 2-L); on par or better than OPRO with more interpretable, more robustly transferable structures.
compute_cost_profile: Very low overhead: only 3 extra inference calls at the task level (SELECT/ADAPT/IMPLEMENT) for the whole task, then standard single-pass decoding per instance. Reported as 10-40x fewer inference-compute than inference-heavy ensembles such as CoT + Self-Consistency / per-module majority voting, while being more performant. No training cost (training-free).
known_limitations: Gains are uneven by task type: largest on tasks requiring world knowledge, only moderate boost on algorithmic tasks vs CoT; small gain on MATH because 74.7% of MATH failures are computation errors that a better structure does not fix. The seed set is a fixed 39 reasoning modules (from Promptbreeder), and the structure is composed at task level (not adapted per instance), which can be suboptimal for heterogeneous instances (motivating later instance-level variants). Evaluated mainly on strong proprietary/large models (GPT-4, PaLM 2-L); no code release identified.
oracle_or_external_feedback_dependency: intrinsic-only — Self-Discover uses no external tool, verifier, ground-truth label, or environment reward. Stage 1 uses only unlabeled task examples; the model composes the structure purely from its own meta-reasoning, so improvements do not rely on label leakage or oracle feedback.
self_correction_efficacy: net-positive — improvements are obtained without any oracle/label feedback (intrinsic, training-free), and are consistent across BBH/T4D/MATH and multiple model families; however the magnitude is task-dependent (large for world-knowledge/social-reasoning tasks, modest for algorithmic/computation-heavy tasks).
calibration_effect: not-measured — the paper does not report confidence calibration or overconfidence ('reasoning tax') effects.
failure_attribution_capability: n/a — Self-Discover is a reasoning-structure composition framework, not a failure-attribution/diagnosis method. (It includes a descriptive post-hoc error analysis on MATH but does not classify, attribute, or counterfactually localize failures as a capability.)
failure_mode_addressed: Targets reasoning-strategy mismatch: a single fixed prompting strategy (e.g. plain CoT) being suboptimal for a given task. By composing a task-intrinsic structure it mitigates poorly structured / strategy-mismatched reasoning. Relating to MAST-style modes, it addresses the planning/strategy-selection side rather than step-level verification, inter-agent misalignment, or in-flight error recovery.
dataset_or_benchmark_released: No new dataset/benchmark released; evaluation uses existing benchmarks (BBH, T4D, MATH). Appendix releases the 39 seed reasoning module set and prompt templates (the 39 modules are adopted from Fernando et al. 2023, Promptbreeder).
builds_on: Chain-of-Thought (Wei et al. 2022; zero-shot CoT Kojima et al. 2022), Plan-and-Solve prompting (Wang et al. 2023), Step-Back prompting (Zheng et al. 2023), decomposition/least-to-most prompting (Zhou et al. 2022a; Khot et al. 2022), Self-Consistency (Wang et al. 2022), and Promptbreeder (Fernando et al. 2023, source of the 39 atomic reasoning modules); inspired by human problem-solving / reasoning-program theory (Newell et al. 1958; Rasmussen 1983).
extended_by_or_inspired: iSELF-DISCOVER (instance-level adaptation of Self-Discover, arXiv:2507.03347, comparing dynamic structured-JSON vs unstructured CoT reasoning); Auto-Evolve (Aswani et al. 2024, dynamically adapts/evolves reasoning modules for more diverse problems); cited by reasoning-LM surveys/frameworks (e.g. Besta et al. 2025 modular RLM framework) and self-improving reasoning works (e.g. Self-Reasoning Language Models / SRLM, ACL Findings 2025).
reasoning_model_native: no — developed and evaluated on non-reasoning-native models (GPT-4-turbo-preview, GPT-3.5, PaLM 2-L, Llama2-70B) before o1/R1-style reasoning models; it externalizes/scaffolds an explicit reasoning structure rather than relying on built-in reflective decoding. Applicability to reasoning-native models is not evaluated.
on_policy_distillation_link: weak/indirect — no weight updates or distillation; relates to skill/prompt-optimization in that it composes reusable reasoning structures from a seed skill set and shows cross-model transfer (a prompt-level, not on-policy-distillation, analogue of skill reuse). Not an on-policy distillation method.
sample_efficiency: Highly sample-efficient at the task level: the reasoning structure is discovered in 3 task-level inference steps using only a few unlabeled task examples (no labels, no training), then reused across all instances; no iterative trial budget per instance.
